steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What condition should be added to the A button pressed event to check that the Player sprite is standing on a wall tile, when it’s on land?


Solution:

A Boolean OR operator || should be added to the if condition in the A button pressed event, that checks if the bottom of the Player sprite is hitting a wall tile at the bottom: 

(swimming || bearSprite.isHittingTile(CollisionDirection.Bottom))


Ask the ninja: 

❓How might the spriteImage function parameters be used to check if the sprite is facing right AND swimming?


Solution:

A second Boolean parameter, named isSwimming, should be added to the spriteImage function definition. A Boolean OR operator || and the isSwimming parameter should be added in each of the conditions inside the function definition. Each condition should be unique and 2 of the conditions should use a Boolean NOT operator ! to check if isSwimming is false.

Ask the ninja: 

❓ What loop can be used to make something happen while a certain condition is true?


Solution:

A while loop should be added inside the onUpdateInterval loop, with a condition that checks if the length of the array of Food sprites is less than 6. The makeSalmon function call should be placed inside of the while loop.
steps.instructions:
Fix the bugs in the code to create a working platformer game!


The Player sprite should be able to jump only if it is swimming or standing on a platform tile.


The Player sprite’s image should be changed in the spriteImage function, based on whether it’s facing right or swimming.


Food sprites should only be created when there are fewer than 6 Food sprites on screen.


Use the functions in the code menu and the code completion tool to create a working version of this 2D platformer project!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 3 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about using physics and Boolean values to control game conditions in 2D platform tilemap projects. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 3:

badges.title: Taking Control
badges.description: Control the way sprites move and appear on screen in a 2D tilemap project in JavaScript.

badges.title: Gravity of the Situation
badges.description: Use physics to control a sprite’s velocity and acceleration in a 2D tilemap project in JavaScript.

badges.title: Checkin’ it Twice
badges.description: Check for a specific tile image at a specific tilemap location.

badges.title: While You’re At It…
badges.description: Use a while loop to make something happen while a certain condition is true.

badges.title: And the Winner Is…
badges.description: Create a function that uses Boolean operators and values to determine which sprite image to use.

badges.title: Well-Rounded Character
badges.description: Edit an image asset to create multiple versions of an image that faces different directions.
